_about: License and papers of every source dataset, keyed by the source label of data/datasets.json rows; "projects" maps a family/project key to a different entry where one source has more than one license. Author given names are abbreviated to initials. Checked and turned into data/citations.bib by tools/build_site_data.py. Licenses of the UMI-family entries follow the UMI Data Initiative table (https://umi-data.github.io/).
